title: Depression screening in adults, including pregnant and postpartum persons and older adults

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for depression in the adult population, including pregnant and postpartum persons, as well as older adults.

action: Screen adults for depression, including pregnant and postpartum persons and older adults.

derived.min: 'adult' is taken to mean age 18 or older; the number 18 is not stated in the section text

derived.window: the text gives no screening interval; an annual (measurement-year) window is assumed for checking and must be confirmed by a human reviewer
